dialogue: I think you're warmed up by now, so let's take it easy. What level of Quest shall you go for?
I suppose you can handle something like that, can't you?
This Quest requires a contract fee of {zenny}. You still want to try your hand at this Quest?
Hmm... Looks like your wallet isn't fat enough to afford this Quest.
When you're ready to set off, head down the path in front of you and press the {button:03} button when you get to the entrance of the village. Good luck!
Something else I can do for you?
Hmm... Giving up? If you change your mind, come back and visit me whenever you'd like. An old lady needs friends, ya' know!
What's the matter? You'd like to cancel the Quest contract you took out?
That's too bad... I'll cancel this contract for you.
Hmm... Giving up? If you change your mind, come back and visit me whenever you'd like. An old lady needs friends, ya' know!
This Quest seems to be about the perfect level for you. Would you like to give it a try?
When you're ready to set off, head down the path in front of you and press the {button:03} button when you get to the entrance of the village. Good luck!
Something else I can do for you?
Hmm... Giving up? If you change your mind, come back and visit me whenever you'd like. An old lady needs friends, ya' know!
Yes. Yes indeed. It seems I can leave lots of things up to you, can't I? What level of Quest would you like to take?
Ahh... Our village hunter. Seems like you've been working very hard lately! What level of Quest would you like to take?
Yeppers. Sometimes you want to push yourself with a Quest and sometimes you just want to relax. What level of Quest would you like to take?
Well well! It looks like you're all fixed up! When I heard that a hunter had fallen in the Snowy Mountains, I was so shocked!
Oh my... I haven't introduced myself! I'm the chief of this village. It's called Pokke. Can you believe an old lady like me can be village chief!?
I'm hoping I can convince you to settle down as a hunter in this village. You know the house you woke up in? You can stay there as long as you'd like.
Anyways... I suppose you're not used to a hunter's work yet, so would you mind heading off to the Training School first?
At the Training School, you can take "Beginner Training". That would be a good place to start.
See the huge building on the left? That is the Gathering Hall. If you take the road to the left of that, it will lead you to the Training School.
Go down that path and press the {button:03} button to enter the Training School. Please talk with the instructor there. Everyone holds him in high esteem.
Well well! It looks like you're all fixed up! When I heard that a hunter had fallen in the Snowy Mountains, I was so shocked!
Oh my... I haven't introduced myself! I'm the chief of this village. It's called Pokke. Can you believe an old lady like me can be village chief!?
I'm hoping I can convince you to settle down as a hunter in this village. You know the house you woke up in? You can stay there as long as you'd like.
Anyways... I'd like you to show me your strength by completing an easy Quest that was requested nearby here. That's OK with you, right?
Huh? You're still recovering? Well, once you feel up to it, you can try some of the Quests from other areas. But first you should rest up a bit.
That reminds me, if you head to the "Guild counter", you can initiate various Quests. You see the large building on the left don't you?
That's the Gathering Hall. Inside you'll find a branch of the Hunter's Guild. If you want to take out a multiple hunter Quest, that's your best bet.
For details, head over and ask the person at the counter. Oh, I forgot to give you some money. It's not much, but it's enough to get started.
On the right you will find a general store that sells many great items. Next to that is a shop selling armor and weapons. Go there for equipment needs.
If there's something you don't understand about hunting, go to the Training School. You see the path to the left of the Gathering Hall, right?
Go straight down that path and press the {button:03} button, to go to the Training School. If Quests are getting too hard, go there to toughen up!
Hmm... Well then... Good luck out there! Don't overdo it, OK!? I'm looking forward to watching your progress!
First things first... Go have a chat with the instructor at the Training School. It's the best way to get started in the hunting business.
To get to the Training School, head down the small path next to the large Gathering Hall you see on your left.
Go all the way down the path and press the {button:03} button to enter the Training School. There you can start your "Beginner Training".
So you went to the Training School, huh? If you're not sure what to do or Quests are getting too hard, head over there as often as you'd like.
Oh yes... I suppose it's time I give you details about your job. As one of our hunters, you will settle down here in Pokke Village.
I think it is time you had some real-life training under your belt, so try one of the easy Quests that take place nearby.
Once you're ready, you can also try the Quests from other areas. But first you should warm up a bit.
That reminds me... If you head to the Guild counter, you can sign up for various Quests. There is a branch inside the Gathering Hall.
If you want to take on a Quest with multiple hunters, that is the place to do it. You can ask them in person for more details.
Oh, that reminds me! I forgot to give you some money for your contracts! It's not much, but it's enough to get started.
On the right you will find a general store that sells many great items. Next to that is a shop selling armor and weapons. Go there for equipment needs.
Hmm... Well then... Good luck out there! Don't overdo it, OK!? I'm looking forward to watching your progress!
Well it looks like you've been trying your very hardest indeed. By the way, have you ever heard of a Giadrome?
Up in the Snowy Mountains, there is a species of monster called a Giaprey. Actually, the Guild likes to call them White Velociprey...
The leader of the pack of Giaprey is called the Giadrome and I was hoping that you would get rid of it for me.
And don't just think of it as an oversized Giaprey, because it is not. If you get hit with one of its ice shots, your body will be frozen stiff.
Also, if it feels threatened, it will run off to a different part of the field to recover.
You can try to use brute force, but if that proves too hard, try using a Flash Bomb or Shock Trap to stop the Giadrome's movements.
This village has had enough of that Giadrome and it's a perfect opponent for you. Please finally rid us of that scourge.
Oh thank you! Thank you very much! It seems you took care of that Giadrome without any problems!
If you are that strong, then maybe I should give you other Quests. We got some Quests that are in the Jungle and the Desert areas!
The Jungle has many geographic features like caves and cliffs, so until you get used to it, it's easy to get lost.
The Desert is a harsh landscape with a wide barren zone and a zone of rough rocks. It has Health draining hot days and Stamina sucking cold nights.
Depending on the Quest, it will take place either at night or during the day. When entering the Desert, check the time and prepare yourself.
Both zones are home to powerful monsters. You can find more information in a book I left on the bookshelf at your house.
You came at the right time. I've got a favor to ask of you. A strong wyvern has appeared in the Snowy Mountains, and it's coming towards us.
Thankfully the damage so far has only been to livestock, but leaving this be would be a recipe for disaster...
Ahh, yes. The name of the wyvern is Khezu. It is a white monster that can fire off electrical attacks.
It is completely blind, so as with a Giadrome, you can't stop it with a Flash Bomb, but you can with a Shock Trap.
If you are as strong as I think, you'll have no trouble defeating it... Just don't overdo it.
If you think this is too hard for you, try some other Quests to build up your armor and weapons. That should make it OK.
You are just as strong as I imagined if you took care of that Khezu. Everyone is grateful for your help. I'll have a reward for you later.
I have a harder request this time. You'll need to really give it your all. The request is in the Swamp as well as in the Forest and Hills.
The Swamp doesn't have any major geographic features, but at night, toxic chemicals can rise up out of the ground, so you'll have to take precautions.
The Forest and Hills have an abundance of items to gather, but powerful wyverns are known to appear there... But you should be OK!
If you want to know more about these areas, check your bookshelf. There are books with info there, so give them a read now and then.
If a monster is beyond your grasp, gather materials and work on your equipment because there will be more monsters than just a Khezu in these parts.
Last night, I heard a distant Pelagus roar... Take care of yourself. Save your strength when you can.
Hmm... It seems you are becoming quite strong. Which is good because it seems like our old friend is back...
A long time ago, a Blangonga nested in the Snowy Mountains. It was a rowdy beast, but a previous generation of hunters drove it away.
Now the Blangonga has returned. It must have learned that the old guard of hunters had retired.
The Blangonga itself is an extremely powerful beast, but it also leads a pack of Blangos, so you can't let your guard down for even a second.
You might not be able to drive it away, but I think you can still hold your own against the beast. The village is counting on you!
Hah hah hah! You slayed the Blangonga! I knew you had it in you! I'm just so thrilled you've gotten so strong!
Now that I know how strong you are, I can trust you with this job over in the Volcanic zone.
The zone is an even hotter area than the Desert, so protect yourself against the heat. There are many gathering points, and you may find rare ore.
I also have to mention that there have been rumors lately of a monster called an "Elder Dragon" appearing close by.
They are fiercely territorial, and move within their own bounds. You can't always fight them, but you may come across one someday.
Oh! I forgot about your reward for defeating the Blangonga! It's something nice that I'm sure you'll find useful.
Well then, you're back. There is something I must urgently talk with you about. It's about none other than Tigrex.
It is a wyvern that once attacked this village before you arrived here. Now Tigrex is back in the area.
One of the reasons it is here is to hunt Popos, and as you know, Popos are one of the workhorses of the village.
The Popos we have domesticated are already under attack. However, the Tigrex's appetite does not stop at just Popos...
We'd like you to rid us of this threat. Don't worry, you are more than prepared for the challenge.
Please show us all your strength. If not for the village, then just to prove something to yourself. I beg you for your help.
I just heard! You did it! You defeated the Tigrex! This old lady always had faith in you!
With you here, this village can rest easy. You've really become our star hunter. I can't thank you enough.
By the way, we've just gotten the autopsy report back from the Guild. It seems that the Tigrex you slayed yielded incredibly rare materials.
One of them was a large Tigrex Screamer. It's something Treshi and I have spent ages searching for. It has special properties...
It has all the properties needed to smash the ice barrier in the farm storehouse. What an incredibly rare item indeed!
It's something you only see once in a lifetime and that's why it is beyond the skill of the staff at the crafting shop.
I know it was a bit presumptuous of me, but I used this item for you. It was for the good of the village.
I suggest you take a trip over to the farm. You should be able to see the demolition of that ice barrier.
Oh, there is one thing I forgot! Here is a small token of my appreciation... I hope it comes in handy.
You're truly our star hunter. Slaying that Tigrex made you such a celebrity that we've received another difficult request for you.
Are you aware of the Rathalos, known as the king of wyverns, and his queen, the Rathian?
They are said to live in the Forest and Hills, thus they aren't often spotted near here...
The request we received for you is to slay these two beasts. They are both powerful flying wyverns, there is no doubt about that. Take care, OK?
You repelled the Rathalos and the Rathian... It's not too much to say that you've become a first-class hunter.
Your fame keeps getting bigger and bigger, and we keep getting more and more requests for you!
It seems we have the services of a first-class hunter. I should congratulate you! I'm sorry for always giving the same kind of gift...
If you are truly as strong as you seem, you shouldn't limit yourself to my requests. Try the ones at the Gathering Hall. You should go there.
Ahh... Our hunter. You came just at the right time. The Guild has sent a request for assistance, and we'd like to ask for your help!
Your opponent is the giant monster Shen Gaoren. While it is a Carapaceon, it is far larger than even a wyvern!
In the town, the Guild have installed various weapons such as a Ballista or a Dragonator. Go there and use these weapons.
With your strength, there is no way the Guild will meet defeat, but that doesn't mean you can become overconfident!
Ahh... Our hunter has returned. It seems you had no trouble slaying that Shen Gaoren.
You've received an official reward of thanks from the town. You should take it over to the crafting shop.
Hmm... As strong as you've become, it seems like my small requests are a waste of your abilities.
You should try to take the high level Quests found at the Gathering Hall. As a hunter, it is important to keep aiming higher.
Also, I'd like to introduce you to the Felyne to my right, Nekoht. You two should talk. Once you become stronger, you should be able to help her.
Keep reaching for new heights! You are the hunter of Pokke Village after all!
Ahh, our village hunter. It seems like you've taken care of nearly all of my requests.
In fact, this is the last Quest that I can give you.
This final Quest is extremely difficult. In fact, you should first take some higher level Gathering Hall Quests and improve your equipment.
Your final test will challenge you to your very soul.
Marvelous! Our hunter makes us proud once again! To get rid of two Rajang in one fell swoop is an absolutely amazing feat!
Even though I don't have any more Quests that I can give you, that doesn't mean your path as a hunter has reached its end.
At the Gathering Hall, you should be able to find Quests that fit your advanced level.
From now on, I'll have to settle for admiring your progress. I do have a reward for you though. You should find it quite useful...
Ahh... Our village hunter! I heard from the Guild Manager at the Gathering Hall that you slayed an Akantor! Unbelievable!
I'm so proud of you! You took care of an Akantor even when the Guild itself could not.
Hmm... It's been such a long time since I've heard that name...
My ancestor... I've heard that it was he, a cave-dwelling man with a giant sword, who fought against the Akantor and drove it to the Volcanic Belt.
That heroic deed is why the local Felynes still pass down the story of the Akantor in their folklore.
So for you to have slayed an Akantor... Who knows what fate your story will have. All I know is you are truly the Pokke Village hunter.
This is my village. Pokke Village. Can you believe an old lady like me can be village chief!? If you'd like to take a Quest, come by anytime.
Ahh... Our village hunter!
As I always say, health above all else. I think it's time to turn over a new leaf and renew our spirits.
There aren't a lot, but a few new requests came in. I hope you'll take a look. There's bound to be a few that will catch your eye.
Now then, allow me to introduce you to that Felyne there. She's the Guild's... no, I mean the daughter of an old acquaintance... Or was it grandchild?
...Well, a descendent of some sort, in any case. People here call her "Nekoht".
Now then, I hope you will lend her a hand. She receives all the hardest requests and needs someone strong to take them on.
But heed my words: her Quests are not easy. They are not the sort of jobs that just anyone can fulfill...
Hmm... Perhaps it is best not to rush into them and to go at your own pace. Good luck either way.
Ahh... Our hunter returns! Thank you ever so much for defeating the Ukanlos.
The Guild had issued an evacuation order because they had no idea when and where it would attack.
A few hundred years ago, when Treshi and I set up this village, I would never have thought to live to see our village abandoned.
Just the thought of our village dying brings a pain to my heart. But you have saved us, and for that I am eternally grateful.
The Ukanlos you defeated is actually a twin of sorts to the Akantor. They're referred to as the "Twin Walls".
My ancestor, the cave-dweller with the giant sword who chased the Akantor out, is not buried here because the Ukanlos sealed his fate for him.
The poor man, he was never able to return to his homeland. In a way, I built this village to follow in his footsteps.
And to think that a hunter of this village has now brought the Ukanlos down... My my, what an interesting maiden Fate is.
As the village chief and as just another old lady, I thank you from the depths of my heart, our dear village hunter.
Welcome! What can I do for you today? From everyday items to items essential for your hunt, we have everything you need!
Thank you. Come back soon.
Well, hello there. You're the new hunter, right? This general store should have all of the various items you need.
We carry everything from daily necessities like Herbs to the various specialty items needed for a hunter's life. Let us know what you need.
Unfortunately ever since the last hunter retired, our normal supply routes have dried up... So we don't have our full compliment of stock.
That's why we've been looking forward to your arrival for so long. Your success will mean we will be able to return our stock to normal!
Welcome once again! You've come at just the right time too! One of our supply routes opened up and we just got in some new items!
Look at this one! This is the Organizer Guide we just got in! It increases the space of your Item Box. Isn't that incredible?
How about the Book of Combos 3. It's our pick for hunters who like to combine during a Quest. We've also got bowgun shells and lots of other items!
Welcome! So you got rid of the Blangonga, huh? Well, thanks to you, we've been able to stock even more items!
Here's one of the new items we got in. It's the Book of Combos 4. If you carry it along with Books 1, 2, and 3, your success rate will skyrocket!
We've also got some new monster info. I figured you would be interested because a hunter of your level requires the latest information!
Finally, we received some powerful bowgun shells and a wide assortment of useful items.
Welcome again! I've got excellent news! A new supply route has opened and it is all thanks to you!
We've now got some excellent products to show you! I recommend the Mega Pickaxe and the Mega Bugnet. They are both very hard to break.
Another recommendation is the Book of Combos 5. Using it with the other books will make combining failure a thing of the past.
We've also got a great item for a hunter like yourself! In the dark about elder dragons and their ilk? Not for long with a collection of monster info!
Welcome! Thanks to you, this little village has become famous! Our supply routes have increased to the point there's no more stock room!
Thanks to our great stock, I can recommend some items today! How about the Backpacker Guide. It'll increase your Item Box capacity to the limit!
We were also able to stock some shells for Gunners. Particularly the Pellet S Lv3 and Pierce S Lv3. We've also gotten in some new monster info.
The fact that we are so well stocked is 100% thanks to you. Truly, we can't thank you enough.
Welcome! I heard you have risen to High Rank Quests. Congratulations!
Thanks to you, I've been able to restock to the brim, and obtain new items for sale. I've also got some new information on monsters for you.
It's about monsters that live in the Great Forest, not that I know much about that area. I wonder what it's like?
I've also got this Yellow Seed. I don't quite know what it is, but I'm sure it'll be of some use to you, so please buy it and give it a chance!
Welcome again! I heard the Guild has recently been all abuzz about a new monster.
Which reminds me, I got a new book in! Here it is, Akantor Info. It seems to be an especially scary monster.
Make sure you pick up a copy. It can only help, right?
Welcome! I hope you're doing well.
I received some information about a new monster recently. I heard there is a terrifying monster in the Great Forest of late.
I also got these Yellow Seeds in. I'm not sure what they are, but please buy some. I'm sure they'll turn out to be quite useful.
Welcome! Today's your lucky day. I received a really good item today!
It's Armor Stone! I'm sure you know all about it already, but I'm also sure it's been quite hard to get a hold of, am I correct?
I've managed to find a steady supplier, so you don't have to worry! I'm just glad that I was able to do so since you just became G-Level.
I get the feeling you'll be needing a lot of these. Please feel free to come buy them at any time.
Hello... meow! So you need new weapons or armor? If you don't have materials, this is the purrfect place to buy them. What can I do for you, nya?
Thank you! Thank you! Come back soon, meow!
Meow! So you need new weapons or armor? Don't nya know that it is impurrtant that hunters have the best armor and weapons!?
If you have materials, then the crafting shop next door can make something for you. But if not, then you'll have to buy your items brand new, meow!
I'll even sell you armor that they can't craft next door! Next time, I'll get some purrific armor for you, meow!
It's just right now our stocks are a little low, nya... But when you don't have materials, step right up! But buy a lot... I've gotta eat, meow!
You're back, nya! Would you like some new weapons or armor? We've gotten some hunter's goods in just for you, meow!
We've got items that are purrfect for those who aren't satisfied with just a Mafumofu! Give the Chain line, Hunter line, or Battle line of armor a try!
But those lines of armor aren't very good at keeping out the cold, meow. If you are going to the mountains make sure to take purrcautions, meow!
It's you, meow! To celebrate you slaying that dodo Blangonga, we've stocked some new armor!
We've got three pairs of special boots made from special alloys. Try the Silver Metal Boots, Dark Metal Boots, or Pink Metal Boots, nya!
They can't be crafted from materials, so they're really beautiful boots! They have high defense too! I wish I was a puss in boots, meow!
But not the pink boots because those are only worn by women! Anyways, have yourself a look, nya!
Ahh! You're here! You're here! Meow! Meow! We've got some amazing armor set aside made from a special alloy paws above the rest, meow!
The Chrome Metal Coat and Chrome Metal Boots are black with a gold line that's absolutely the cat's meow... I'm purring just thinking about it, meow!
If I was a hunter, I'd definitely wear them, nya! Sorry, I got carried away... You should still check out that armor though, meow!
Yo yo and hello! For improving bone weapons you're gonna need bone material. Try a Popo for Brute Bone or a Giaprey to get some Small Monster Bone!
Ho ho, come back soon! Stop by anytime you've got some good materials!
Yo yo and hello! To improve iron weapons, you'll need all types of ore! To mine ore, use a Pickaxe at a Mining Point. Then mine away!
Yo yo and hello! To improve armor, you'll need an Armor Sphere. You can improve one part by one level by using one sphere. It's like a rule of one!
Improving a melee weapon makes it stronger. Depending on the weapon, you could even craft something with the same abilities.
Yo yo and hello! If you improve armor, its defense will rise, but Skills and Slots are fixed, so don't fret. Your precious skills will remain untouched.
Yo yo and hello! The armor improving Armor Sphere has advanced versions too! There is the Armor Sphere+, Hard Armor Sphere, and more! Try and get 'em!
Yo yo and hello! On a high ranking Quest you'll have the chance to get high quality materials! These materials can be made into high power armor!
Yo yo and hello! Are you using Decorations? They won't be lost if you've removed them or improved your weapon, so use them as much as you'd like!
Yo yo and hello! Wait... Wait... YOU'RE THE VILLAGE HUNTER! Thanks to you, our business is thriving!
Yo yo and hello! You're the new hunter, aren't you? I look forward to working with you in the future.
This is the Equipment Shop. It's two shops in one. The Weapons Shop sells completed items and the Crafting Shop makes or improves weapons and armor.
When you don't have materials you should visit the Weapons Shop and talk to that darn Felyne. All you need is money to buy armor or weapons from him!
Now if you got some materials and want to make new equipment, I'm your man! All you need is materials and money... I can make anything.
If you want to improve weapons or armor, I'm also your man. You'll need materials and money for bows or melee weapons. Bowguns only require money.
Improving armor will require special materials and money... Huh? What materials you ask? I'll tell you about that later. Patience, grasshopper.
Oh, I forgot to mention Decorations. When it's time to add Skill Points to armor or weapons, I'm the man you need to see.
To be honest, it's not a stretch to say that hunters wouldn't be able to continue their vocation without my skills.
Anyways, if you happen across any new materials, you know where to come.
Yo yo and hello! Have you gotten used to the life of a hunter yet?
I have something nice for you today. A new kind of revolutionary material made via the latest technology developed by the Workshop Union.
It's called an Armor Sphere. Armor Spheres are special materials used to improve armor. One sphere can improve one piece of armor by one level.
Any line or type of armor can be improved; however, the number of levels it can be raised by an Armor Sphere is fixed for each piece of armor.
Armor Spheres can be obtained as a reward, or they can be combined by using Armor Stone and either a Killer Beetle or Machalite ore.
The more of these you obtain the more you can improve. Why don't you try improving your favorite armor and see how it works first hand.
Yo yo and hello! It seems like you are progressing well as a hunter.
I have something nice for you yet again. Have you ever heard of Decorations? You can attach them to weapons and armor.
Weapons and armor have open holes called slots. These slots can be used to attach Decorations.
Decorations are endowed with Skill Points, so attaching them to your armor might activate the ability to use a new skill.
Crafting a Decoration requires a material called a Jewel. There are various types of Jewels, such as the Akito Jewel and Suiko Jewel.
Since you seem to be a little light right now, I'll give you a few Suiko Jewels. Use these to commission Decorations for your weapons and armor.
Removing a Decoration does not break it, so try as many different ones as you'd like! Of course, I'll be charging you to make them!
Yo yo and hello! Word on the street is you rid us of a Blangonga. Mighty fine job if I do say so myself.
I figure you deserve something to commemorate the event. Remember that Suiko Jewel I gave you? Well this time I have an even nicer Jewel!
It's called an Akito Jewel. You can use it to make the Expert Jewel, which raises your Affinity through the Reckless Abandon skill.
You can also make an Early Bird Jewel, which triggers the Reloading Speed skill and allows you to quickly reload your Bowgun or Bow.
You can obtain an Akito Jewel in the Swamp or the Forest and Hills; however, the best way to get them is mining in the Volcanic Belt.
I'll give you a few now so you can try them out and see what they do. Of course, leave taking on and off Decorations to a professional... Me.
Yo yo and hello! I hear you were able to hunt down a Tigrex! That's amazing!
This calls for a celebration! Remember that Armor Sphere I gave you...? Well, if you want to improve armor, than this is even better!
It's called an Armor Sphere+, and it allows you to strengthen armor that can no longer be improved with a simple Armor Sphere.
Like an Armor Sphere, it will improve one piece of armor one level, no matter the linage or the part.
However, an Armor Sphere+ only improves things that have already reached an Armor Sphere's limit. You can't use them from the start.
I also hear you can make an Armor Sphere+ by combining an Armor Stone with Dragonite Ore or Hercudrome.
Try improving your favorite armor with this. I think you'll be pleased with the results... Especially the results at my crafting shop!
Yo yo and hello! Looks like you are hard at work these days. Everyone is quite proud of you.
I've got a gift for you today. A Jewel much nicer than anything I've given you before.
It's called a Battlefield Jewel. Use it make improved versions of your current Decorations and unlock even more useful skills.
Combining that Jewel with materials allows you to create wonderful items.
As a key item in creating Decorations, sometimes you'll need multiple pieces. If you get new materials, come here and see what's possible.
To get a Battlefield Jewel, your best shot is mining the Volcanic Belt. Especially the mining points in caves, the summit, or the volcano's base.
Now that you know what you need to know, time to head out into the field. You know... Use this to do that and get on with it! But come back soon!
Yo yo and hello! It seems that you've gotten yourself almost ready to try some of the higher ranked Quests. You've made the village proud!
I think you'll need this as you progress the ranks. It is an incredibly important material used when improving armor.
It's called a Hard Armor Sphere. It is used to improve items beyond the ability of an Armor Sphere+.
Just like before, you can't use a Hard Armor Sphere until you've used an Armor Sphere+ to improve your armor. That's very important, so don't forget it!
Combine an Armor Stone with Carbalite Ore or a King Scarab to create a Hard Armor Sphere.
If you have any armor that has been improved with an Armor Sphere+, try improving it even further. Of course, you'll allow me to provide the labor!
Once you've raised to this rank, you will be able to craft high-end armor, such as S-Series armor or U-Series armor.
If you get valuable materials, bring them over here! I should be able to make you some new armor!
Yo yo and hello! Our village hunter! It seems that your stock just keeps going up and up!
Huh? Why are you looking at me like you are expecting a handout!? Maybe because I have one for you! The ultimate Jewel itself!
It is an incredible Jewel that can only be obtained on High Rank or higher Quests. None other than the Lapis Lazuli Jewel!
There are plenty of places to encounter it during a high ranking Quest, so you should be able to obtain it while mining for other types of ore.
Limited to only high ranking Quests, possessing this item allows the crafting of incredible Decorations provided you have other rare materials.
For instance, the Lapis Lazuli Jewel is indispensable when creating high Skill Point Decorations that take up three slots.

By the by, have you heard of the monster known as "Nargacuga"? It is a recently discovered creature which the Guild seems quite interested in.
A black wyvern with a love of the dark, it dwells in the Great Forest. Its strength is so great that even the Guild's research team is no match.
Needless to say, they were not able to gather much information, so we need you. Will you go to the Great Forest and do this for us?

It is astounding, absolutely astounding. You defeated the Nargacuga on your own, nya!
Hmm, I do believe it is time to grant you the right to initiate the highest-ranked, Level 9 Quests.

I have great expectations of you, so please give it your all. Also, this may not be much, but it should help in some way. Farewell for now.

Good day, Leader! Thank you very much for hiring me, meow!
Just a friendly reminder, but you can now take us Felyne Comrades with you on quests! Here's to some good hunting!
Feel free to direct our activities through the "Comrade Board", meow! It's that blue board there on the right-hand side.

But the most important thing you can do is under the "SelComrade" command, meow! This is where you choose which one of us gets to go on quests with you.

A Comrade will grow in accordance with its training. Carefully consider how to train each Comrade based on its temperament and Comrade Skills, meow.
If you want to know more, please see the "Info Magazine" on your bookshelf. That about wraps it up! Train us well, oh fearless leader, meow!
Hello, Leader! As thanks for your cooperation in expanding the Felyne Comrades, I'd like to present you with this, meow!
I hope we can count on your continued support in the advancement and development of Felyne Comrades, meow!
Hello, Leader! You may be a stranger to me for now, but that won't stop me from giving it my all! I'll do my best to make us both proud, meow!
Ha ha, this is what they call a "pep talk", but if we keep our spirits high, we can make a real name for ourselves throughout the world!
How do you do? Thank you for hiring me, meow!
This is where you can raise and train us Felyne Comrades that you can then take on quests with you.
I hope you'll keep me on for a long time to come, meow!
Nothing's more important than the basics, including training, which raises various stats. But you can't just do it willy-nilly, meow!
Depending on the training regiment, different stats go up. You have to figure out which stat you'd like to raise, and then go after your goal, meow.
Among the training options is "Rest". And as I always say, never underestimate the importance of resting!
The stats you can build aren't limited to just skills, meow! By allowing a Comrade to rest, that Felyne's Fondness for you will increase a little.
Fondness level affects how we Comrades behave while out on a quest, so it's an important stat to raise, meow!
While we've got this bond going, why not nurture it? I think we can expect great things from each other for it, meow!
Felyne Comrades that go on quests with you will gain valuable experience, meow.
After a while, that Comrade will level up, so if you want to raise a Comrade's level, make sure to take it out on a lot of quests, meow!
Our attack, defense, and other stats rise bit by bit as we level up, meow.
So please take us out on as many quests as you can! We want to be tough and strong too, meow!
Did you know, nya? We have special skills that we can use called "Comrade Skills", and dare I say they're all mighty special and really useful, meow!
To learn the various skills, you'll need to trade in some Comrade Points, so plan ahead wisely, meow.
Did you know, nya? Some Comrade Skills start out hidden, and must be unlocked before they can be learned.
They are automatically unlocked when certain requirements are met. The trick is to take us out on quests and let us build up some experience, meow.
A high Fondness stat is a very good thing, trust me. The higher the Fondness, the more likely we are to act according to what you need, meow.
For example, we'll be more likely to come to your aid if you should faint or be caught in a tight spot during a quest.
It doesn't help you or your Comrades in any way to raise us in a manner counter to our temperament, meow.
For example, making a Comrade who likes to attack learn defensive skills becomes pointless. Better to build upon our strengths, you know?
For a Comrade that likes to attack, I suggest building its inner strength, fortifying its power to match its fiery temperament.
For a cat that loves bombs, I'd suggest teaching it "Large Barrel-Bomb" and "Bomb Strength Up" to create the master Furball of Fire, nya!
If your partner is of the strong-cat type, it's sure to have enough latent power to bring a monster down.
Brave cats should learn "Status Atk Paralysis", "Abn Status Atk Up", and "Affinity Attack" to become the ultimate lethal weapon, meow!
So what if you want a cat who's more of a ball of healing light than a ball of fire? What's a good combo of temperament and skills, meow?
Well, you can teach a cowardly Comrade "Health Flute", "Demon Flute", and "Armor Flute" and it'll sit in the back and heal you all day long.
Do you wish for more money, oh fearless leader? The life of a hunter sure can get expensive, am I right, meow?
For those times, you might want to try this combination: "Rob 'em Blind" and "Hyperdrive". As they say, a cat is fast and sneaky by nature, nya!
I didn't know what to make of you at first, but surprisingly, now I think you may not be such a bad human after all, meow.
I guess it's true. You can't judge a book by its cover. Here's to more good hunting in the future, meow!
I was just thinking... We've really come a long way, haven't we? We've learned so much and we work so well together.
We've been there for each other through thick and thin, and I still look forward to each day. I really do see how we grow and change every day, nya.
Looking back, I can tell you that I've really learned a lot, meow... I still remember the first day I met you, Leader.
This house... This is where my heart calls home now. And as long as I get to be by your side, I'm satisfied, meow!
Do you know about the Comrade Skill "Status Atk Paralysis"? With it, there's a fixed probability that a cat's attack will cause Paralysis, meow.
If you want a Comrade to learn it, try hunting a monster that has that particular ability, like a Genprey, meow.
With the Comrade Skill "Status Atk Poison", a Comrade has a fixed probability of causing Poison with an attack, meow.
If you want your cat to learn it, try hunting a monster with that skill, nya. Let's see... Poison... Oh, I know! Gypceros are the perfect specimen!
The "Status Atk Sleep" Comrade Skill is a happy skill indeed! With it, your Comrade has a fixed probability of causing Sleep with its attack!
But first, you have to hunt something like a Hypnocatrice or a Basarios, and then once one of us learns the skill, be sure to return the favor, nya!
Did you know, nya? The "Element Attack Up" skill is one very special skill. It increases the effectiveness of all elemental attacks!
To learn it, you're going to have to hunt down some Rathalos or Rathians. They're tough, but it'll be worth it, trust me. Give it a go, meow!
"Abn Status Atk Up"... I know it's a lot to remember but try to, OK, because it's worth that much as a skill, meow.
If you want this skill that increases the effectiveness of all status-causing attacks, then you must hunt monsters like the Plesioth and Lunastra.
As the name suggests, "Hyperdrive" is a skill that makes a Comrade's movements and actions super fast, meow.
If you want your cat to learn it, you'll have to hunt something fast... like a Kirin. It's a great way to make the natural speed of a cat even faster!
I'm going to tell you about the safe and special skill "Speedy Recovery". With it, your recovery speed goes up, so it's useful on long quests.
Now you want it, don't you, meow? In that case, you're going to have to collect a lot of experience. No way around it. All you can do is hunt and wait.
If there's one skill that is sure to help, it's "Health Up". This skill increases the max Health of a Felyne Comrade, meow.
To learn it, try hunting a monster with a ton of Health, like a Congalala or maybe a Blangonga, meow!
One Comrade Skill you can really depend on is "Attack Up", meow. Its effect is to boost your Defense. Haha, just kidding, meow!
You have to hunt down a monster such as a Diablos or a Monoblos to learn this skill. Kill or be killed, as they say. That's the law of Nature, meow!
Learning the "Defense Up" skill will make hunts a breeze. Just as the name says, your Comrade's defense will go up, allowing it to withstand more damage.
But before it can be learned, you've got to make it back alive from a Basarios or Gravios hunt, nya. Ah, an ironclad hunter's spirit awaits, meow!
"Guard Percentage Up"... This should be pretty obvious. It increases the chances that your Comrade will guard effectively against an attacker.
You should try to hunt some monsters that will give your cat this ability, nya! I'd say your best shots are Daimyo Hermitaurs and Shogun Ceanataurs!
"Bomb Strength Up" is a nifty skill that increases the explosive power of Small and Large Barrel-Bombs, meow.
The only way to learn this skill is to increase our Fondness of you, meow. See, being good friends with us has quite a few advantages!
For those cats who are always falling victim to bombs, the "Bomb Dmg Reduction" skill will come in handy, meow.
With it, your cat will take only 1/2 damage from any and all bomb attacks. Your cat should learn it on its own with enough experience, meow.
Today, I'm going to tell you about a very special, sharp skill: "Say No to Gathering"!
In exchange for not being able to gather, your Comrade's attack drastically increases, meow! Make use of this when you want to keep your eye on the prize!
If you want your cat to learn this skill, you're going to have to train it well. Remember to take it out on quests, meow!
Today's tip is about the Workaholic skill. That's not to say that we Comrades don't work our tails off on a regular basis, but you know what I mean, nya.
Once learned, this skill allows your cat to work extra hard, but at the expense of some of its maximum Health...
You know, it's kind of like real life in that respect, I guess... meow. If you take your cat on quests, it'll learn it eventually. Use it wisely, meow!
Did you know there is a skill that embodies the "never say die" spirit? It's called "Fall 7x, Get Up 8x", meow.
It's one of our most powerful skills! We cats lose to no one, meow! After fainting, we'll revive each time with our attack power increased, raaaawr!
I can't recommend this skill enough! Build up experience to learn this awesome ability, meow!
I'm going to let you in on a little secret. When you want to put your bravery to the test, try using the special "In a Corner" skill, meow.
With this skill, your cat's attack and defense will go way up, but if it faints, it won't be coming back... Well, not for that quest anyway.
The choice to learn this skill will become available with enough experience, so I encourage you to give it a go if you have the time and patience.
Do you know about the "Shock Trap" skill? It's very useful for when you're going head to head with large monsters, meow.
Depending on the situation, this skill allows your Comrade to set up Shock Traps. The higher your cat's Fondness, the more likely it'll set them.
I hope you'll take us out on many, many hunts, meow! I'd love to learn such a useful skill!
One of our best skills is "Rob 'em Blind", meow. With it, there's a chance that your cat will steal some material with every attack!
With higher Fondness, that probability goes up as well, meow. So wish us luck as we endeavor to gain enough experience to learn this skill, nya!
"Large Barrel-Bomb" is a bit of a luck-based skill, meow. With it, there's a chance that a Small Barrel-Bomb will turn into a Large one from time to time!
With higher Fondness levels, the chances of Large Barrel-Bomb level damage also shoots up. If you want your cat to learn it, take it out on quests!
For an attack that can't be beat, try an "Affinity Attack"! With this skill, there is a chance that your cat will land a critical hit, meow!
Experience is the key here, but don't forget to increase our Fondness for you as well, meow!
I strongly recommend learning the "True Health Flute" for those times when you need something more than a simple Recovery Horn, meow.
The secret to this skill is our Fondness level, so the better friend you become with us, the more we can be of help to you, meow!
I can't stress enough how useful of a skill "Clairvoyance" is when tracking large monsters, meow.
It only lasts for a second each time, but the higher our Fondness, the more we can perform the skill. Experience is the key to unlocking it, meow.
I don't think I have to explain the where, when, and why's of Poison Negate, but it is great for when you are surrounded by poisonous creatures.
You should try to have a Comrade learn it by hunting down Iopreys or Iodromes. The spirit of poison resides in poison, after all, meow.
If your cat has the Earplug skill, it's a great way to block out deafening roars, reducing your prey into cat food, meow.
If you want your Comrade to learn this skill, you'll have to hunt something like a Yian Garuga or a Tigrex. Um... Good luck, meow!
The "Wind Negate" skill renders heavy winds produced by large creatures useless. Those are some strong, anchoring paws, meow!
But it doesn't negate all winds. Gotta stay on your toes around Wyvern Wind... I mean, wait, don't... Um, in any case, experience unlocks this skill.
You really like to use Great Swords, huh? No need to hide it from me, Leader, I already know, meow.
I can sense that you love their long reach and raw power! They're a must-have to you, am I right, meow?
You give off the aura of a true hunter, meow. You use Long Swords the most, after all.
I can see it in the way you stay cool, and in the intensity of your concentration! It's amazing how well you use a weapon that requires such timing!
You're a true hunter who has mastered the basics, meow. Your trusty Swords are a physical manifestation of your hunter's heart, meow.
You're adaptive under any circumstance, and your choice in weapon, which requires both brains and brawn, shows the depth of your knowledge, meow.
Oh, I see you're the aggressive type! You really love to use Dual Blades, huh? I don't think anyone can even come close to you, meow!
You take care of all sorts of problems in the blink of an eye! That takes real guts, you know, meow!

Horns pack a punch, but they also provide support through their melodies. Is this what it's like to be at ease, meow...? It's a wonderful feeling.
For Lances to be your weapon of choice, you must be a righteous person, Leader. Your bravery is absolutely stunning! Ooh, I'm getting the chills...
The ability to aim at the heart of things serves you well with any weapon, and to be able to see the truth marks you as the very essence of a hunter!
You're as good as they come, nya! Hunters who love Gunlances are real experts, always at the ready!
With excellent timing, you let loose some Wyvern's Fire between shots, and your cool judgment makes you an invaluable ally, meow!
Don't worry, I understand how you feel, Leader. You've chosen the rapid-firing, long distance Light Bowgun to be your main weapon...
And that means you appreciate the many varieties of rapid-firing shells, right? A hunt's not a hunt if it's always the same, nya?
You're one very determined human, I can tell! To use Heavy Bowguns this much and this well shows you're truly a warrior, meow!
You're like a sniper, shooting your target down with a precision and power beyond compare! Talk about a real warrior's weapon, meow!
You've got the world within your sights with the Bow! Now show the world what you're made of: swift justice, straight and true.
Aim for the prize with your exquisite stance and let loose an arrow untethered. That is the true path of a hunter, meow!
Do you dislike Great Swords, Leader? I guess they are a bit cumbersome, and it takes a while to fully draw one, meow.

I dare say that Great Swords are iconic of hunters everywhere, with a multitude of fans worldwide, meow. How about giving it a fair chance, Leader?

The best thing about them is how cool they look when you're fighting with a group. Truly the model sword in my opinion, so give them a try, meow!
Hmm? You're not that great with a Sword? You've got to be more positive about these sorts of things, Leader! Don't focus on a single aspect, OK?

You can safely perform all sorts of maneuvers and it's incredibly well-balanced, nya! The possibilities are limitless. You should really give it a try!

But you know, those demerits are easily overlooked when you go all out with them! Plus they're a great way to help you train to be more defensive!

Listen, I completely understand how you feel about Hammers, Leader. They're heavy and hard to use, right, meow?

It's extremely well-balanced between offense and support, almost ideally! What do you say? Will you give this weapon a chance, meow?

The "aim from outside your foe's attack range" style of fighting trains you to look for good places to fire from, meow.
Gradually, your movements and hunter's sense will become more and more natural, nya. If you have the will and stay strong, you will overcome, meow!
Ah, Leader... your dislike of Heavy Bowguns might be to your disadvantage, nya. I don't know, but maybe you're too used to what you have, nya?
But in a way, Heavy Bowguns combine the best of long-range and short-range weapons, nya. You can even outfit them with a Shield.
It's a flexible weapon that allows you to adjust according to the distance between you and your foe. Even if you're not a pro, it packs a hard punch!
Leader, I will now tell you what you are thinking, nya. Behold! "Bows are terrible against small monsters." Is that not right, meow?

You are a real hard worker, Leader! You completed all of the Group Training exercises, after all! That's really impressive, meow!
You must be a born hunter! Is this what the true hunting spirit is all about? But please remember to get enough sleep and rest too, meow!

You should go on more Quests. Let's go from amateurs to pros!

M-Meooooow!! Th-This is absolutely amazing! You've collected all of the Awards!!

I... I'm overwhelmed with emotion to have met such an incredible Leader, meow!! ...*oogle*...

Looks like you've raised your Hunter Rank, meow! I bet you feel like you're on top of the world right now, nya!
You're on the right track, that's for sure! Keep up the good work and you'll get there, meow. Besides, life gets boring with no goals, right?

I'm keeping a record of all of your successes and failures, meow. You should be proud of yourself, meow!

Meow! We Comrades are feeling mighty fine, as though we're on top of the world, nya. We're starting to become real hunters, nya!
But we know there are even more quests out there, so please take us on more quests and let us level up, nya!

Leader, Leader! Look! Look at our levels! Aren't they impressive, meow?
